messages:
Maya (Finance): Heads up - JuiceCare (customer) invoice INV-2026-304 for USD 48,500 attempted this morning and failed. Gateway returned 3DS timeout + country mismatch (billing country US, auth country listed KG). last4=4242, tx=0xabc123. We have a renewal scheduled tomorrow. Any quick ops workarounds before service flags?

Sam (Payments): Can you paste the raw gateway response? is there an acquirer_id? 3DS_TIMEOUT usually means the ACS didn't respond - could be transient but geo mismatch is weird.

Maya (Finance): Pasted below from the gateway logs:
```
{"status":"declined","decline_code":"3ds_timeout","acquirer":"prime-rail","acquirer_id":"pr-07","billing_country":"US","auth_country":"KG","auth_code":null,"tx_id":"0xabc123","amount":4850000}
```

Sam (Payments): Thanks. Looks like the acquirer routed through a gateway node in KG for some reason. Two quick options: 1) retry through alternate acquirer (we have fallback to fast-pay), 2) ask customer to re-auth the card (3DS flow) or provide wire. I'll attempt an immediate retry on fast-pay if finance approves.

Nora (Acct Exec): JuiceCare is on an annual committed plan, high value. I tried calling operations contact but got voicemail. Chris from Sales is reaching out now. We should avoid auto-suspending.

Chris (Sales): On it - called billing contact (Lina), she's traveling and can't complete 3DS right now. She said they can do a wire if we provide instructions. Prefers wire to force no outage.

Eden (Risk): Hold on manual wire - need quick KYC check. Also we should check for possible fraud: sudden auth country mismatch + high amount is a flag. If Sales can confirm the payer identity and PO, we can whitelist for this invoice only.

Maya (Finance): Understood. If we do retries, please limit to 3 attempts and notify me so I can mark invoice as "retry in progress" in billing portal. If retries fail, we'll accept wire and mark paid on receipt.

Sam (Payments): I'll queue retries: immediate (attempt 1), +1h (attempt 2), +6h (attempt 3). I'll route retries via acquirer fast-pay. If any attempt returns auth, I'll capture and post proof.

BillingBot: To create a manual wire instruction, run: `/create_wire INV-2026-304 JuiceCare 48500 USD` - this will generate bank details and legal language.

Nora (Acct Exec): Chris, please ask for an emailed confirmation from the customer (PO or explicit wire consent) and forward to finance@redwood.com. Eden - can you do a lightning KYC (match company registry + billing contact) and give an OK/NO here?

Eden (Risk): Starting quick KYC now. ETA ~30m. If the contact email domain matches the org and PO number matches invoice, I can greenlight a one-off override for wire.

Chris (Sales): Lina said she'll email a scanned PO within 45m and can do wire today. I'll post it here when I get it.

Sam (Payments): Actioning retry schedule now. I'll post status after each attempt. Also enabling routing flag to prefer fast-pay for JuiceCare for the next 24h to avoid the KG routing node.

Maya (Finance): Thanks. If retries fail and we get PO, I'll approve the manual wire and mark invoice as pending bank clearance. Please avoid any auto-dunning until we resolve - I'll toggle invoice hold.

Eden (Risk): Quick KYC complete: company registry matches, billing contact matches, small mismatch on IP in last login but client says travel. Given sales confirmation and PO pending, OK to proceed with wire if retries fail.

Sam (Payments): Attempt 1 (immediate) -> DECLINED (fast-pay): decline_code=issuer_restricted. Attempt 2 (+1h) queued.

Maya (Finance): Noted. Keep the hold. Chris, watch for the PO.

Chris (Sales): PO arrived, attached in email thread to finance@. Lina confirms wire today, will copy me on payment confirmation.

Sam (Payments): Attempt 2 -> SUCCESS. Auth code 9F3K2H. Captured USD 48,500. Posting receipt now.

Maya (Finance): \u2705 Received. Marking INV-2026-304 as paid. Thanks everyone. Chris, confirm with Lina that the charge is expected.

Chris (Sales): Confirmed - Lina says charge looks right. She apologizes for the inconvenience. :thumbsup:

Nora (Acct Exec): Closing on our side. I'll add a note to customer record about 3DS failure and we should monitor for similar routing anomalies.

Maya (Finance): Filing a quick post-incident note in billing ops about the acquirer routing abnormality. Sam - can you add a short log snippet and the acquirer override we used?
